scope: Three entry policies, three costs, three previously viewed periods; original stop, target and EMA50 exit retained. No combined filter or exit-policy selection.
rules: After a qualifying baseline setup: slope = direction sign * (current EMA50 - previous completed 1h EMA50) / current Wilder ATR14; separation = abs(current EMA20 - current EMA50) / current ATR14. Inclusive thresholds. Source and previous must be adjacent with identical seeded history origin.
evaluation: Exploratory on already-viewed 2024-2025 data. Thresholds fixed before this replay but informed by earlier diagnostics; no fresh holdout or optimization claim. No live strategy promotion. Compare losses, costs, drawdown, trade counts and mean R across all periods. Freeze all three policies for forward observation.
